# Sawir Studio

> Sawir Studio finds what's slowing your business down and fixes it: one system in place of the spreadsheets, AI for the busywork, Shopify connected to Odoo, websites and apps, looked after for years.

Every page below is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `index.md` to its URL as linked here.

## Studio

- [Sawir Studio](https://sawirstudio.com/index.md): Sawir Studio finds what's slowing your business down and fixes it: one system in place of the spreadsheets, AI for the busywork, Shopify connected to Odoo, websites and apps, looked after for years.
- [About](https://sawirstudio.com/about-us/index.md): Sawir Studio ships apps, websites and designs fast, with AI in the loop and a human owning every call. Read our founder's note and what we believe.
- [Ricardo Sawir, Founder of Sawir Studio](https://sawirstudio.com/ricardosawir/index.md): Ricardo Sawir is the founder of Sawir Studio. He builds apps and software for clients and as the studio’s own products, from Rindraw to WordPress plugins.
- [Press kit](https://sawirstudio.com/press/index.md): Sawir Studio's press kit: logos, brand colors and fonts, company facts, a short boilerplate and the founder's bio and photo, free to use.
- [Contact](https://sawirstudio.com/contact/index.md): Tell us about your project. Applications, websites, and digital design.
- [Privacy](https://sawirstudio.com/privacy/index.md): What sawirstudio.com collects, why, and which services handle it: Microsoft Clarity, the contact form, Google Fonts and Cloudflare.
- [Terms of Use](https://sawirstudio.com/terms/index.md): The terms for using sawirstudio.com: our content and portfolio, the free WordPress plugins and apps, links to other sites, and how client work is agreed.
- [Launch & Growth](https://sawirstudio.com/launch-and-growth/index.md): We build sites and apps to be found, then help people find them: search setup, local search, listings and earned backlinks, and a monthly check-in.
- [Shopify Integrations & Apps](https://sawirstudio.com/shopify/index.md): Shopify connected to Odoo and the rest of your business: orders, stock, payouts and point of sale, by the people who wrote the open-source Shopify connector for Odoo.
- [Odoo & Custom Business Systems](https://sawirstudio.com/odoo/index.md): Point of sale, stock, purchasing and accounting in one system: Odoo set up for how you work, built to measure when it doesn't fit, or both. From the people who write Odoo modules.
- [Custom Software & Apps](https://sawirstudio.com/custom/index.md): Apps, internal systems, marketplaces and portals built around how your business works, with payments, integrations and the admin behind them. You own the code and the data.
- [Forward Deployed Engineers](https://sawirstudio.com/forward-deployed-engineering/index.md): A forward deployed engineer inside your team, priced by the outcome: a short fixed-price look at the work, then one price for each result before we build it, putting AI to work in your systems and connecting what you already run.
- [Clients](https://sawirstudio.com/clients/index.md): The companies and institutions Sawir Studio has built for, and what we built for each of them.
- [Our Work for PeopleBond](https://sawirstudio.com/clients/peoplebond/index.md): What Sawir Studio has built for PeopleBond: PeopleBond HCMS Application, PeopleBond Connect App and PeopleBond Website.
- [Our Work for Vivaldy Skin Clinic](https://sawirstudio.com/clients/vivaldy-skin-clinic/index.md): What Sawir Studio has built for Vivaldy Skin Clinic: MyVivaldy, Vivaldy Skin Clinic Website and Vivaldy Skin Clinic Marketing Design.
- [Our Work for Capsule Indonesia](https://sawirstudio.com/clients/capsule-indonesia/index.md): What Sawir Studio has built for Capsule Indonesia: Digital Airport Hotel Design and Capsule Indonesia Design.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/index.md): Applications, websites and designs by Sawir Studio, from client projects to our own apps on the App Store.
- [SawirPost](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/sawirpost/index.md): Write a post once and publish it to 25+ social channels on schedule, built for agencies
- [Sawirly](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/sawirly/index.md): A privacy-first URL shortener with no tracking and links that can expire
- [Quill Word Counter](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/quill-word-counter/index.md): A free word counter that also shows reading time, post length limits and the words you repeat
- [NoFapFit](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/nofapfit/index.md): An instant exercise challenge for the moment an urge hits, with streaks to build discipline
- [Par](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/par/index.md): Par is a full RPN financial calculator for iPhone and iPad with the classic gold-key keystrokes: TVM, loans, NPV, IRR, bonds and more.
- [CleanStorage](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/cleanstorage/index.md): CleanStorage finds duplicate photos, large videos and repeated contacts on your iPhone, so you can decide what to keep. No ads, no subscription.
- [Pawlitics](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/pawlitics/index.md): A cozy cartoon politics sim where a town of animals reacts to every policy
- [Squishu](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/squishu/index.md): Squishu is a cute clicker game for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch: squish dumplings and beat each world’s boss before the steam runs out.
- [Rindraw](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/rindraw/index.md): A drawing app where every stroke stays editable. Pay once for iPad, iPhone and Mac.
- [Math Daily](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/math-daily/index.md): Math Daily builds a daily math habit in a minute a day with the Math Monsters: quick practice in addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
- [WordPress Plugins](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/index.md): Twelve free WordPress plugins by Sawir Studio: subscriptions, referrals, restock alerts and more for WooCommerce, plus tools for any WordPress site.
- [Shopify Connector for Odoo](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/odoo-shopify-connector/index.md): An open-source Shopify connector for Odoo 19 Community, written by Sawir Studio and maintained in the Odoo Community Association (OCA).
- [Colvaron Conquest](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/colvaron-conquest-website/index.md): Colvaron Conquest is a strategic trading card game by Coco JM, published by Sawir Studio and free to play in the browser. We also designed and built its website.
- [MyVivaldy](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/myvivaldy/index.md): MyVivaldy, the clinic system and patient app for Vivaldy Skin Clinic: booking, visit history and prescriptions on iPhone and Android, built by Sawir Studio.
- [Jetfly Case Study: The Aircraft Owners' Portal](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/jetfly-owner-portal/index.md): Case study: since 2023 Sawir Studio has been the main developer on Jetfly's aircraft owners' portal (formerly my.fly7.com): costs, revenue, hours flown, logbook and invoices in one place.
- [Aeroquote Case Study: Air Charter Quoting Software](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/aeroquote/index.md): Case study: in 2022 Sawir Studio worked on Aeroquote, air charter software for operators and brokers: quotes, quote documents from Word templates, fleets, a broker plan and the marketing site.
- [My Spiritual Journey Case Study: GBI WTC's Daily Devotion App](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/my-spiritual-journey/index.md): Case study: My Spiritual Journey, GBI WTC's app for daily Spiritual Workouts, with badges, friends and church classes. On the App Store and Google Play, built and looked after by Sawir Studio since 2022.
- [Koperasi HOB Application](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/koperasi-hob-application/index.md): Koperasi HOB’s shopping app: members browse household goods by category, choose delivery or pick-up, and pay with their cooperative balance.
- [DBTV Application](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/dbtv-application/index.md): DBTV brings Ps. Debby Basjir’s sermons, prayer services, worship, podcasts and daily devotionals to iOS and Android. Built by Sawir Studio.
- [Kantong Sayur Application](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/kantong-sayur-application/index.md): Vegetable and grocery shopping app and website for KantongSayur, built by Sawir Studio.
- [PeopleBond Case Study: Payroll That Keeps Up With Indonesian Tax Law](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/peoplebond-hcms-application/index.md): Case study: since 2019 Sawir Studio has worked on PeopleBond's HR and payroll platform, keeping PPh 21, Coretax and BPJS in step with Indonesian law.
- [PeopleBond Connect Case Study: Attendance That's Hard to Fake](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/pbconnect/index.md): Case study: pbConnect, PeopleBond's employee app for iPhone and Android. Tap in with location and face checks, leave and overtime approvals, and payslips, built with PeopleBond since 2021.
- [PeopleBond Website Case Study: A Bilingual Site That Sells the Product](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/peoplebond-website/index.md): Case study: in 2026 Sawir Studio rebuilt peoplebond.id in Indonesian and English, with a page per module, integration and industry, free HR calculators and demo requests that never get lost.
- [TaniMilenial Application](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/tani-milenial-application/index.md): TaniMilenial mobile app for farming, fishery and livestock, built by Sawir Studio with Clicks&Co.
- [Growinc Group Website](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/growinc-group-website/index.md): Corporate website for Growinc Group Indonesia, a Jakarta marketing and advertising group, with its services, case studies and agencies. Built by Sawir Studio.
- [Fluindo Technology Indonesia Website](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/fluindo-technology-indonesia-website/index.md): Website for Fluindo Technology Indonesia, designed and built by Sawir Studio.
- [Calvin Kain](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/calvin-kain/index.md): Application built for Calvin Kain by Sawir Studio, in partnership with Clicks&co.
- [Indonesia Research Institute Japan Website](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/indonesia-research-institute-japan-website/index.md): Company profile website for Indonesia Research Institute Japan, designed and built by Sawir Studio.
- [Vivaldy Skin Clinic Website](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/vivaldy-skin-clinic-website/index.md): Website for Vivaldy Skin Clinic, a dermatology and venereology clinic, presenting its treatments, shop and contact details. Built by Sawir Studio.
- [Adiwarna Company Profile Website](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/adiwarna-company-profile-website/index.md): Company profile website for PT Adiwarna Anugerah Abadi, designed and built by Sawir Studio.
- [SPP Indonesia Website](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/spp-indonesia-website/index.md): Website for PT SPP Indonesia, a fire pump specialist, with a page for each pump type from end suction to vertical turbine. Built by Sawir Studio.
- [Habitat Hills Design](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/habitat-hills-design/index.md): Tri-fold brochure for Habitat Hills, a 27-hectare nature resort in Megamendung, Bogor, designed by Sawir Studio in forest green and terracotta.
- [JakPod Hotel Design](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/jakpod-hotel-design/index.md): Identity design for JakPod Hotel, a pod hotel in Thamrin, Jakarta: a JAK monogram in a pink-to-blue gradient circle, by Sawir Studio.
- [Astra International ESR Info & Tips](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/astra-international-esr-info-tips/index.md): ESR Info & Tips, an illustrated safety, health and environment book for Astra International, designed by Sawir Studio around two friendly characters.
- [Digital Airport Hotel Design](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/digital-airport-hotel-design/index.md): Design work for Digital Airport Hotel, for client Capsule Indonesia, by Sawir Studio.
- [Capsule Indonesia Design](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/capsule-indonesia-design/index.md): Product brochure for Capsule Indonesia’s capsule units, designed by Sawir Studio in silver and blue, with each pod’s features and where it fits.
- [Tanda Tangan Digital Campaign](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/tanda-tangan-digital-campaign/index.md): Digital signature campaign design for Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Informatics by Sawir Studio.
- [Vivaldy Skin Clinic Marketing Design](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/vivaldy-skin-clinic-marketing-design/index.md): Marketing design for Vivaldy Skin Clinic by Sawir Studio, such as an Eid al-Fitr greeting card in the clinic’s soft white and turquoise palette.

## WordPress plugins

- [Sawir Renew – Recurring Billing for WooCommerce](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-renew/index.md): Complete subscriptions for WooCommerce — recurring billing, trials, sign-up fees, pause/skip, plan switching, dunning, smart retries. All free.
- [Sawir Referral – Refer a Friend for WooCommerce](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-referral/index.md): Give-and-get referral program for WooCommerce. Friends get a discount, advocates earn a reward coupon — shared by code or link, WhatsApp-first.
- [Sawir Pulse – Live Sales & Social Proof for WooCommerce](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-pulse/index.md): Sawir Pulse shows shoppers what is really happening in your store, such as recent orders, people viewing a product and fresh reviews, as small notifications…
- [Sawir Restock Notifier for WooCommerce](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-restock-notifier-for-woocommerce/index.md): Let customers request an email notification when an out-of-stock WooCommerce product is back in stock.
- [Sawir Min Max Quantities for WooCommerce](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-min-max-quantities-for-woocommerce/index.md): Set minimum and maximum purchase quantity rules for WooCommerce products, product categories, and the whole order.
- [Sawir Product Image Zoom for WooCommerce](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-product-image-zoom-for-woocommerce/index.md): Adds a product image lightbox with navigation and click-to-zoom to WooCommerce product galleries.
- [Sawir Variation Gallery Tools for WooCommerce](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-variation-gallery-tools-woocommerce/index.md): Manage variation-specific gallery images in WooCommerce. Works with Sawir Product Image Zoom for WooCommerce.
- [Sawir Insights](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-insights/index.md): Heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, funnels, and form analytics. Everything stays on your server.
- [Sawir Social Scheduler](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-social-scheduler/index.md): Write once, schedule to 27 networks from wp-admin. Per-channel edits, threads, media, previews. Your tokens stay on your server.
- [Sawir Live Translate](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-live-translate/index.md): Sawir Live Translate translates your pages where they stand: pick a language, auto-translate what is visible, save it, and give visitors a language switcher.
- [Sawir Media Folders](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-media-folders/index.md): Fast, unlimited folders for the WordPress media library with drag & drop.
- [Sawir Role Capabilities Manager](https://sawirstudio.com/projects/wordpress-plugins/sawir-role-capabilities-manager/index.md): Create custom user roles and manage capabilities for new and existing WordPress roles.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/index.md): Articles from Sawir Studio on building web applications with Laravel and PHP.
- [OpenAI Will Pay for Your AI Coach: What OpenWorks Covers, and What It Doesn't](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/openai-openworks/index.md): OpenAI's OpenWorks pilot pays local AI experts up to $8,000 a month to help US small businesses for free. Who can apply, what free coaching covers, and when you need someone to build the system instead.
- [Services Is Next: What a Few People with AI Agents Can Deliver](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/services-is-next/index.md): A thread from Ethan Mollick, BuccoCapital and Aaron Levie says services firms are next to be remade by AI agents. What that looks like from inside a firm already working that way, and what it means for clients.
- [What Is a Forward Deployed Engineer?](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/what-is-a-forward-deployed-engineer/index.md): Forward deployed engineers work inside a customer's team and ship software into their systems. Why the role is suddenly everywhere, and when a smaller company should borrow one instead of hiring.
- [Sawir Studio Now Publishes Colvaron Conquest](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/sawir-studio-publishes-colvaron-conquest/index.md): Sawir Studio is now the publisher of Colvaron Conquest, Coco JM's strategic trading card game. Play it free in your browser at colvaronconquest.com.
- [Shopify 2026-10 API: What Breaks](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/shopify-2026-10-api-what-breaks/index.md): The Shopify Admin API changes in version 2026-10 that can break an integration, and what to change: shipping rates, draft order discounts, taxes, barcodes and more.
- [Shopify Script Tags End March 2027](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/shopify-script-tags-stop-march-2027/index.md): Shopify stops running online store script tags on March 1, 2027. Which apps it affects, how to check your store, and what replaces them.
- [Connect Shopify to Odoo 19 Community](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/connect-shopify-to-odoo-19-community/index.md): How to connect a Shopify store to Odoo 19 Community with the open-source OCA Shopify connector: the Dev Dashboard app, scopes, queue_job, webhooks and onboarding.
- [Why Shopify Payouts Don't Match Your Books](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/why-shopify-payouts-dont-match-your-books/index.md): Why the money Shopify Payments sends to your bank never matches your sales report: fees, refunds, disputes, gift cards, currency conversion and timing, and how to reconcile it.
- [WordPress 7.2: What Plugin Authors Should Test](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/wordpress-7-2-what-plugin-authors-should-test/index.md): WordPress 7.2 is due December 8, 2026. What changes for plugin authors, from Application Passwords and the proposed Secrets API to the Interactivity API router, and how to test now.
- [WordPress Abilities API for Plugins](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/wordpress-abilities-api-for-plugins/index.md): How to register abilities in a WordPress plugin so AI agents and other tools can discover and run them safely: categories, schemas, permissions, annotations and the REST endpoints.
- [WooCommerce or Shopify in Indonesia?](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/woocommerce-or-shopify-indonesia/index.md): WooCommerce or Shopify for a store in Indonesia: monthly costs in rupiah, payment gateways and QRIS, the transaction fee Shopify adds, shipping, and which fits which business.
- [Making Our Sites Agent-Ready](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/making-our-sites-agent-ready/index.md): How we made our product sites readable by AI agents: Markdown copies of every page, Link headers, llms.txt, Content Signals in robots.txt, an API catalog and Agent Skills.
- [Throwable App Icons with Matter.js](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/throwable-app-icons-matter-js/index.md): How we built the box of app icons you can throw on our home page: Matter.js for physics, DOM elements instead of a canvas, a shadow that stays put while icons spin, and fallbacks.
- [Build Your Own CMS Like WordPress](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/how-to-build-your-own-content-management-system-like-wordpress/index.md): Building a content management system like WordPress with Laravel and modern software architecture.
- [Subscription Plan Limits in Laravel](https://sawirstudio.com/posts/how-do-you-design-your-subscription-plan-restrictions/index.md): How to enforce subscription plan limits in Laravel, from a simple check in the controller to Gates and Policies.
